text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're strong-willed, hate losing, and are 
an honor student of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...And then—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want to acknowledge you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Watching it makes me all restless inside. 
Like a sizzle burning right from the tips 
of my ears!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Your eyes are special.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Not a speck of dirt suits those sparkling 
eyes of yours."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Full of confidence. Those eyes, always 
looking upward.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes, so earnest and fitting for 
someone at the center of the story...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm terrified.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I'm the protagonist too!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm the protagonist who has overcome all 
the ups and downs together with you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I did special training with Vodka-chan and 
Cesario-chan! I trained with Triple Tiara 
Umamusume to attain a special way of 
running!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At the Kikuka Sho! And at the Takarazuka 
Kinen!! We put on some thrilling races, 
didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Don't you go surpassing me so 
easily...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I will beat you...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I'm definitely gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Remember it! My "trajectory"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If this were a story, there'd definitely 
be a hint in there!! A hint to defeat my 
rival!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I got my hands on it at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)! A special move that won't lose 
to anyone's late kick!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If that finishing move won't win it for 
you, then evolve it into a super finishing 
move! Train hard and master a new 
technique!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because that's how the protagonist wins!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're like the protagonist of 
some story! I'm still gonna be the one who 
wins!

While watching Kiseki shout toward the 
setting sun, I organize the data for the 
Japan Cup.
choice_data_list:
(Kiseki will get through this predicament 
too.)

text_block_list.text: ...Kiseki is the main character.

She will definitely come up with a new 
strategy. An entertaining one, worthy of 
defeating a formidable opponent.

"So even without her asking, I know. When 
formulating a strategy for Kiseki, what we 
need next is—"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Trainer <username>! I was able to confirm 
that matter you asked about the other day.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—A practice race right now, focused 
primarily on Leaders and Betweens...!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I thought you might need it around 
now.
Yeah, I figured you'd be needing it soon.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, thank you! It's almost taking 
shape!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My super special move is--!!
"And that night. She came."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I've put together a proposed 
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I believe this is the only way to beat 
Almond-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Only of being "the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"What... What is happening here?! Just 
when it seemed the pace would drop halfway 
through—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Why is Kiseki-chan picking up the pace?!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"K-Kiseki just won't stop! She's in the 
lead! She stays in front—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Because—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If you run the fastest from start to 
finish, no one can catch up to you."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"What a... What an incredible time! It's a 
record! A new world record has been set!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Accelerating even on the final straight— 
truly a front-runner style embodying 'the 
strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Some might call this merely an ideal. They 
might think it's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm a horse girl who takes on 
challenges, and one who inspires hope for 
the future."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, because this heart of mine 
is burning!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Running through the pouring rain as a 
child, I still believe that I can become 
the main character!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even in the Japan Cup! From here on out, 
too! I believe I can be the main 
character!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I just want to win no matter what, that's 
all there is to it—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I want to reach a thrilling excitement 
that no one has ever witnessed before...!"
choice_data_list:
(A story of yours that no one's ever 
seen—)

(A story of yours that no one's ever 
seen—)

text_block_list.text: ...My throat is rumbling.

Right now, at the Japan Cup, —she is about 
to become a legend.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......Does it get you excited too, 
Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As my reader, did it make your heart 
race!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list:
I want to see the ultimate front-running 
style that only you can achieve.

I want to see the ultimate front-running 
style you'll accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it the best race ever and get 
everyone super excited...!!

...I couldn't tell what was streaming down 
my cheeks. But on this day, Kiseki and I 
made a solemn vow.

I made a firm vow that I would definitely 
defeat Almond Eye.
